terms.gloss: the bottom of, the foot of
terms.grammar: adjective, agreeing with the noun for the whole
terms.comment: Latin says the part with an adjective agreeing with the whole: in īmīs collibus, at the foot of the hills (see the top of). When the part is spoken of by itself, pars īma.
